title: Playboy July 1978 Pamela Sue Martin Elvis Poster Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Vintage 1978 issue. Front cover clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light toning on the back cover margins and light edge wear. Complete with centerfold and the LeRoy Neiman Elvis Presley tear-out poster. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, July 1978 issue, original $2.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold and the LeRoy Neiman Elvis Presley tear-out poster.

Cover: Pamela Sue Martin, TV's Nancy Drew. Also: LeRoy Neiman paints Elvis Presley (tear-out poster); Carl Sagan on paranormal junk; ex-CIA chief William Colby interview; Martin Mull's guaranteed make-out guide.

Back cover: Arrow Cordials ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
